fullContentFindings: The supplied positive combustion energies and rounded molar masses give methane 55.625 and propane 50.4545 kJ/g. The per-mole ranking reverses on the mass basis; this is not an absolute chemical energy-rich classification.

Both complete-combustion equations conserve C, H and O; the fresh case requires 1.40449 mol methane versus 0.474158 mol propane, giving direct CO2 masses 61.7978 and 62.5889 g for identical useful heat. Different thermal efficiencies are part of the new model use context.
The upstream-emission question is a limit-of-claim check. It does not demand independently computing a lifecycle inventory or claiming a climate ranking.

Lubricant friction reduction and bitumen road-material binding supply genuine new functional contexts. Leakage, abrasion and long lifetime support qualified judgments; long life alone does not establish a full lifecycle benefit.
The fresh case can be answered qualitatively at BY year 9 NTG/year 10 CH level; no advanced life-cycle calculation is required.

fullContentFindings: Chemistry work-on-system sign convention yields w=-200 J and deltaU=+300 J for +500 J input heat and 200 J outward volume work. DeltaH=+500 J is valid in the stated closed constant-pressure model with only pressure-volume work.
The rigid gas-tight calorimeter has zero volume work and no other work, so deltaU=-800 J. DeltaH cannot be inferred without delta(pV) information.

The revised fully isolated total-system boundary expressly excludes heat, matter and all work, including electrical work. Thus total U is constant while internal chemical-to-thermal conversion may change temperature. This fixes the false equivalence adiabatic+matter-closed=isolated.
assistanceBoundary: Numerical heat/work values, boundary descriptions and image Qv/Qp formulae are supplied help. Correct substitution alone is insufficient.
Classification, sign reasoning, explanation of why U/H changes differ, and rejecting the false isolated/closed and heat/state-property equivalences are independent reasoning.
records.freshTransferFinding: A rigid, open and fully isolated comparison changes the admissible thermodynamic conclusion; it is not a parameter-only repetition.

fullContentFindings: Given gas-phase budgets are internally consistent: 679-862=-183 kJ and 629-732=-103 kJ. The learner need not perform these sums: completion depends on causal explanations involving both breaking and formation, and rejection of the smaller-input shortcut.

The fresh water case gives identical reactant basis and covalent O-H bonds but a liquid product 44.0 kJ/mol lower. An uncued intermolecular-stabilization/condensation explanation correctly supplies the missing model contribution.
No mandatory bond-energy-sum routine remains. The supplied numeric budgets and phase difference support the qualitative molecule/enthalpy relationship expressly bounded in both BY GA and EA.
